Name: Bigger Sheds
Author: Jessebot
TagLine: Expansion to the interior of the shed. Comes with 8 different versions with wallpaper and flooring and configurable through config.json
Description:
Expansion to the **interior** of the shed. Comes with _8 different versions_ with wallpaper and flooring and **configurable through config.json(**instructions are given in the config.json**)**

**- now downloadable from [ModDrop](https://www.moddrop.com/app/)** __(thanks ModScientist)__
__FOR THE PEOPLE WONDERING HOW BIG THE SHED IS, IF YOU INCLUDE THE EMPTY/WALL TILES, THE **SHED IS 32x24** WHICH HAS 768 TILES.__

_**Sheds are now about 4.5 times bigger.**

___REQUIRES SDV 1.3.32+, SMAPI 2.9+ and CP 1.6+__
__This is my first mod. :D__
